complexAnswer:
At revision `3cb07a52f64c522015351c703f416c99cbb5b0ac`, `api.handle` validates the input before passing the original list and injected sender to `gateway.deliver`. Validation accepts lists of strings, including empty lists and empty strings, without transforming them. [api.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/api.py:5), [validation.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/validation.py:1)

A non-list raises `TypeError("records must be a list")`; any non-string element raises `ValueError("records must contain strings")`. An invalid element anywhere prevents all sender calls through `handle`. Exceptions propagate without an accepted response. [validation.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/validation.py:2), [api.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/api.py:6)

`deliver` sends ordered batches of at most two records sequentially. It permits three total attempts per batch, retrying only `TimeoutError`. The third timeout is re-raised; other exceptions propagate immediately. Failure prevents later batches and an accepted response. Any normal sender return ends the retry loop, even a false return value. [gateway.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/gateway.py:1), [gateway.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/gateway.py:6), [api.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/api.py:7)

Earlier batches may have had effects before a later failure. There is no rollback. A sender that performs an action before timing out may repeat that action on retry. This is a possibility implied by the control flow, not observed sender behavior. No sender implementation or network adapter is provided. [gateway.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/gateway.py:8), [README.md](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/README.md:3)

`accepted` is the final `len(records)`, returned only after delivery completes. For an unchanged input list, the response establishes that validation passed and every batch eventually had a sender call return without an exception. Empty input returns zero without a sender call. It does not establish durable receipt, remote delivery, or exactly-once processing. Sender return values are ignored and no durable receipt store exists. The code does not guard against external mutation of the original list, so this is not an independent receipt count. [gateway.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/gateway.py:6), [gateway.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/gateway.py:10), [gateway.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/gateway.py:15), [api.py](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/api.py:8), [README.md](/tmp/juan-final-cases-ionu5tp4/complex/child-checkout/README.md:3)
